# lumos_task_actions (Data Source)

TaskActions DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_task_actions" "my_taskactions" {
  task_id = "...my_task_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String) The ID of the task.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Successful Response (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `action_type` (String) Identifier for POST /v1/tasks/{task_id}:perform-action.
- `transitions` (Attributes List) The possible status transitions for this action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--transitions))

<a id="nestedatt--data--transitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.transitions`

Read-Only:

- `transition_to` (String) The status the task will transition to when this action is taken.
